create_Dataset: create a PyTorch Dataset class that loads video features and text tokens from a list of feature file paths
build_train_collate_fn: build a collate function that pads video sequences and generates start end and highlight labels for training batches
build_test_collate_fn: build a collate function that pads video sequences and stacks text features for test batches without labels
run_get_train_loader: run a function to create a shuffled PyTorch DataLoader with the train collate function for EgoNLQ training
run_get_test_loader: run a function to create an unshuffled PyTorch DataLoader with the test collate function for EgoNLQ evaluation
